paper.title_en: 'Forward-backward' flows and integration cycles for semiclassical Euclidean gravity
paper.abstract_en: Integrating Euclidean semiclassical gravity over real Riemannian metrics is subtle due to the conformal factor problem. A perturbative prescription was given by Gibbons-Hawking-Perry (GHP) where the integration contour for the conformal perturbations is rotated to be imaginary. A potential non-perturbative remedy is that the integration cycles associated to semiclassical saddle points should be deformed into the space of complex metrics in the sense of Picard-Lefschetz theory. Here we propose a non-perturbative construction of such complex integration cycles. This employs a 'forward-backward' gradient flow of the Einstein-Hilbert action, starting at a saddle point, along which the action has monotonically increasing real part and constant imaginary part. The flow is not parabolic. In a neighbourhood of a saddle point, the real part of the conformal factor flows forward and that of the conformal class backwards, with the opposite true of their imaginary parts. Starting the flow at a saddle point, then roughly speaking, one specifies the real part of the conformal class and the imaginary part of the conformal factor at the end of the flow. Solving the flow one finds the complex metrics along a one parameter path within the integration cycle of that saddle, and varying this final data generates the integration cycle, the Lefschetz thimble of the saddle point. We find that near to a real saddle point this reproduces the GHP prescription. We characterise the neighbourhood of a saddle where such forward-backward flows may exist, finding a weaker restriction than that of Kontsevich-Segal-Witten. We numerically demonstrate flows explicitly for 4-dimensional gravity, constructing sections through the integration contours for the saddles given by Euclidean de Sitter, and for Schwarzschild in a cavity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文针对半经典欧几里得引力中众所周知的共形因子问题，提出基于Picard-Lefschetz理论的非微扰复积分圈构造，采用爱因斯坦-希尔伯特作用量的'前向-后向'梯度流；理论深度较高，含明确的数学表述、与GHP方案的对照、与Kontsevich-Segal-Witten条件的比较及四维数值演示，属广义相对论基础方向的实质性工作。
decision.title_zh: 半经典欧几里得引力的“前向-后向”流与积分圈
decision.abstract_zh: 对实黎曼度规积分半经典欧几里得引力时，由于共形因子问题而颇为微妙。Gibbons-Hawking-Perry（GHP）曾给出一种微扰性方案，其中共形微扰的积分围道被旋转为虚。一个可能的非微扰性补救是：与半经典鞍点相联系的积分圈应当在Picard-Lefschetz理论意义下形变到复度规空间中。这里我们提出这种复积分圈的一种非微扰构造。该构造采用爱因斯坦-希尔伯特作用量的“前向-后向”梯度流，从鞍点出发，沿该流作用量的实部单调增加且虚部保持常数。该流不是抛物型的。在鞍点的邻域内，共形因子的实部向前流动，而共形类的实部向后流动；其虚部的情形相反。从鞍点开始流动，粗略地说，人们在流的终点指定共形类的实部与共形因子的虚部。求解该流便可找到沿该鞍点积分圈内一条单参数路径上的复度规，而改变这些终点数据则生成积分圈，即该鞍点的Lefschetz thimble。我们发现，在实鞍点附近，这重现了GHP方案。我们刻画了此类前向-后向流可能存在的鞍点邻域，得到一个比Kontsevich-Segal-Witten更弱的限制。我们对4维引力显式地数值演示了这些流，为欧几里得德西特以及腔中的史瓦西所给出的鞍点构造出穿过其积分围道的截面。
